title_sq: SHESIM 2 VILA INDIVIDUALE NE ZONEN E MULLETIT!
description_sq:
Vilat ndodhen ne zonen e Mulletit perball njera tjetres, te ndertuara ne nje hapsire toke 1200 m2.
Jane shume prane me rrugen cka e ben shume mire te aksesueshme me makine dhe ne kembe.
Vilat jane te ndertuara dhe investuara ne menyre bashkohore me te gjitha materialet e kohes.
 Organizimi total i vilave :
 8 dhoma gjumi
 10 tualete
 2 sallon
 2 depo
 2 veranda
 parking 
Sip ndertimi: 833.2
Siperfaqe e tokes 1200 m2
Vilat jane mundesi shume e mire investimi pasi mund te perdoren per aktivitete te ndryshme si: hoteleri, azil, bujtin, etj.
title_en: FOR SALE 2 INDIVIDUAL VILLAS IN THE MULLET AREA!
description_en: The villas are located in the area of ​​Mullet opposite each other, built on a 1200 m2 plot of land. They are very close to the road, which makes it very accessible by car and on foot. The villas are built and invested in a contemporary way with all the materials of the time. The total arrangement of the villas: 8 bedrooms, 10 toilets, 2 living rooms, 2 storage rooms, 2 verandas, parking, construction type: 833.2, land area, 1200 m2.
